recalls.summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Revuelto vehicles. A software error may prevent the rearview camera image from displaying. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Revuelto vehicles. The gas springs that allow the doors to open and stay open, may fail due to improperly assembled support pins in the springs.

recalls.summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Revuelto vehicles. The oil circuit connection flange screws may have been improperly tightened during assembly, which could cause the oil line to leak.

Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024 Revuelto vehicles. The connecting rod between the passenger wiper arm and the wiper motor may bend and separate from the wiper motor, causing the wipers to fail.

communications.summary: CarPlay connection improvements for the infotainment system; Diagnostic improvements for DTCs without P code information for the OBC; Improved management and performance optimization of the DC DC converter
Service bulletin for the verification and tightening of a bolt on the gas spring bracket which maintains open the front hood while being serviced in order to eliminate possible rattle noise.
Automobili Lamborghini noticed the presence of rust on the washers mounted on the engine bonnet stoppers, therefore these parts which are non-essential can be removed from the assembly.

Service campaign agreed with CARB. Problem: Lateral and longitudinal acceleration sensors need to be monitored by the OBD system. Solution: Introduction of diagnosis for lateral and longitudinal acceleration sensors.
